pieces.Text: You can feel draconic magic pulsing through your veins, and the guttural roar of dragons invigorates you. Whether you're from an area with deep ties to dragons or have simply spent your life studying the magnificent beasts, you understand how dragons' categorization (metallic or chromatic and specific colors) affects their moods, outlooks, and even ultimate goals. You can harness the power of dragons, and you sing the creatures' praises wherever you go.
